Journalist Glenn Greenwald joins Tucker Carlson to discuss Epstein, CNN host Jake Tapper's humiliation, and calls to strike Gaza with nuclear force. Greenwald, who broke the Snowden story, has no sacred cows in media or government. His hour here is fearless by habit.
